started_at.description: Wall-clock time of the first CLI command, written by apply-trace-timing.mjs from the CLI trace. persona-runner does not write it.

duration_seconds.description: Seconds from the first to the last CLI command, measured from the CLI trace. persona-runner does not write it.

timing.description: How action_log.at_seconds was obtained. Written by apply-trace-timing.mjs.

source.description: trace = measured from the Playwright CLI trace (includes model thinking time between commands). none = no trace was available.

matched.description: Number of CLI actions in action_log matched to a trace command.

cli_actions.description: Number of actions in action_log that should correspond to a CLI command.

narrative.description: ペルソナ視点での一人称ナレーション

page.description: 指摘した画面の URL またはパス（例: '/products/new'）。aggregate は page 単位で同じ問題を束ねる

element.description: 画面上の UI 要素名。画面に表示されている文言で書く（例: '「スキップ」ボタン'）

location.description: 自由文の場所の説明。page / element で表せない補足に使う

quote.description: ペルソナの生の声（一人称）

action_log.description: Action trace recorded by persona-runner in the order performed. at_seconds is filled in afterwards from the CLI trace. Drives behavior_metrics computation in aggregate.mjs.

at_seconds.description: Seconds since the first CLI command, measured from the CLI trace. Absent when the action could not be matched to the trace.

target_desc.description: Human-readable description of the element / URL acted upon (e.g. 'メアド入力欄', 'http://x/login').

location.description: Logical screen identifier, e.g. URL or step name. Used to compute time-on-screen and back/cancel rate per screen.

note.description: Optional free-text annotation (e.g. '迷った', '戻った').

hesitated.description: Self-reported by the persona: true when it was unsure what to do before this action. Counted as a behavior signal.
